reviewed_by: Claude: Butler could not find blocked chats by name
reason: Butler told the operator three blocked chats could not be found: the live roster (work.agents) omits blocked chats and nebula.data.search_chats matches one literal phrase in message text, so a multi-name query returned nothing; it never paged nebula.work.chats. nebula.work.chats now takes a title query (any word, case-insensitive, LIKE wildcards escaped) through a new chats_titled helper; search_chats and work.agents descriptions say what they omit, and an empty search carries a hint. Selected the Butler chat paging test (title lookup added), the Butler data tests (empty-search hint) and the execution-scope suite (title lookup runs project-scoped on an execution worker).
exclusions: Message search semantics for the web UI and terminal client are unchanged. No UI change, so no Playwright. test_butler_capabilities::test_scheduled_butler_can_edit_all_assistant_settings already fails on main 35d0be8 and is not selected. Full suites not run.
